courses.title: Inner Child Readings
courses.description: One-to-one readings in which Sarah uses oracle cards, intuition, energy work and simple somatic practices to listen to the younger parts of a client that are asking to be seen. Clients leave with practices for continuing that relationship with their inner child after the session.
